sections.fullText: The monsoons are almost over and we’d like to thank each and every one of the donors who made the season more comfortable for those in need. Thanks to your donations and support, children in orphanages and the elderly in the old age homes we support were able to keep warm and stay healthy.

During the month of October, we onboarded two new NGOs and completed a total of 79 deliveries of clothes, medicines, furniture, toys, books and food items. The donations were carried out across the state in Pune, Nashik, Mumbai and Aurangabad.

Today, we would like to bring to your attention a few new foundations on the SevaDeep platform that may benefit from your donations. If you are in a position to donate the required items to any of these NGOs, simply click the relevant links and complete the donation form.
As always, our team will be more than happy to pick up the items from your doorstep and deliver them safely to the NGO.
Snehalaya Institute for Handicapped:

1.The Thane based NGO supports handicapped children and young adults. The foundation makes a wide range of skill programs accessible to mentally and physically challenged individuals, in an effort to create opportunities for them. The orphanage is in need of five wheelchairs for children between the ages of 10 and 15.
2.Additionally, they also require grocery items such as Rice, Dal, Oil, Sugar, Salt, Masale, Groundnut, Coconut, Dish Washing Powder and Soap.
3.If you would like to extend a helping hand to this NGO, click here.
Kolhapur Zilha Mitra Mandal:

1.The Kolhapur based foundation supports thousands of families in need. Today, they are heavily involved in supporting and rehabilitating over 51,000 individuals who suffered from floods in western Maharashtra.
2.The foundation is in urgent need of food items like Rice, Dal, Biscuits and Flour. They also need a large number of blankets to help keep flood-affected families warm.
3.Click here to know more.
Dnyandayini:
1.This Pune based NGO supports the education of thousands of slum children. Every year, they distribute over 5,000 education kits and get deeply involved in their children’s education journey.
2.They are in need of notebooks, stationery and school uniforms. To know more, click here.

3.Make New Life Foundation: This NGO began their journey in 2007. They provide a safe home for injured and abandoned animals. From nursing to veterinary services, the NGO has cared for over 900 animals till date.
4.They are currently in need of grocery items for the animals. They also require ceiling fans to ventilate the animal shelter. To know more, click here.

At SevaDeep, we are constantly on the look out for NGOs that require support. Through our platform, we bridge the gap between donors and the NGOs and make the process of donating to foundations seamless.
To explore more NGO requirements, click here. Keep in mind that you may also make a general donation to SevaDeep, and we will direct it to the NGO that needs your donation the most.
Don’t forget to us on Facebook for more information, news and updates. For more information on our work, feel free to reach out to Nitin on +919518541719.
